S01: In old Hamburg, in a dust-filled study, Professor Lidenbrock examined ancient manuscripts.
S02: Among the pages lay hidden an old, darkened manuscript by the mysterious Arne Saknussemm.
S04: His nephew Axel, young and curious, looked at the page.
S05: Lidenbrock: "It contains directions on how to reach... the center of the Earth!"
S06: Lidenbrock: "Pack your things. We're going to Iceland!"
S07: The uncle and nephew boarded a ship sailing for Reykjavik.
S08: Through the cold northern seas, before them rose the wild, snowy coast of Iceland.
S09: In Reykjavik they were met by a tall, quiet guide, Hans, experienced in the mountains.
S10: The instructions were clear: they had to climb a huge, extinct volcano.
S11: Lidenbrock: "I hired an experienced guide — nothing will happen to you."
S12: Over rocky paths full of dangers, the three reached the summit and gazed into the dark crater.
S13: Equipped with ropes, lamps and picks, the three began to descend into the volcano's interior.
S14: Deep below the earth, the lamplight revealed rocks that looked like a giant's stairway.
S15: For days they walked, descending ever deeper into the belly of the Earth.
S16: Suddenly, before them opened a vast underground beach beside an endless ocean.
S17: The beach was full of prehistoric plants and enormous bones.
S18: Lidenbrock: "A world from millions of years ago... before our very eyes!"
S19: Lidenbrock: "We shall build a raft and cross it!"
S20: On the raft, in the middle of the underground ocean, the journey became dangerous.
S21: Enormous sea monsters raised waves that shook their raft.
S22: Axel and the professor held onto the raft while Hans skillfully steered through the waves.
S23: When the waves calmed, they realized they had been carried back to the same place they had set out from.
S24: They began to search for another passage and found a narrow cave in the rock.
S25: Lidenbrock: "The initials of Arne Saknussemm! This is the true path!"
S26: But the passage beyond was blocked by enormous boulders.
S27: Hans: "We will blast them with dynamite."
S28: They lit the fuse and withdrew behind the rocks.
S29: The explosion thundered and caused a huge torrent of water to fill the cave.
S30: The torrent carried the three through a narrow, dark tunnel at great speed.
S31: Like flotsam, they flew through boiling water that pushed them upward.
S32: Suddenly light broke through and the water hurled them high into the air.
S33: When they recovered, they realized they stood atop the volcano of Stromboli, in Sicily.
S35: Axel lay on the rocks, laughing with disbelief and joy.
S36: Even the quiet Hans stood leaning, gazing toward the sea.
S37: The three, smeared with soot and seawater, began slowly to descend the volcano's slope.
S38: At night, in a small village by the sea, they gathered by the hearth full of a new tale.
S39: Lidenbrock: "We descended into the earth, and came out of the sky!"
S40: On the table lay the manuscript of Arne Saknussemm, proof of their incredible journey.
S41: Axel smiled, looking at his uncle with new respect.
S42: Lidenbrock: "And we have an incredible story to tell!"
